slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about warehouse-to-port shipment limits and inventory limits, but never asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Truck capacity can be ignored or does not constrain the transportation model.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked how many containers a truck can carry and did not confirm U6 before declaring READY_TO_MODEL.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All P0/P1 hidden slots were resolved; only the P2 truck-capacity detail remained unasked, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent clarified supply-demand handling, integrality, and cost components, then stopped appropriately. It missed the P2 truck-capacity detail and silently omitted that operational constraint.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
